description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

We are looking for an Account Manager to build long-term, supportive relationships with our clients across a wide-ranging customer base. You will look after a portfolio of assigned accounts, help shape partnership plans for them, and actively look for opportunities to grow mutual revenues.

You will take real ownership of your client accounts and act as the internal “voice of the client”. Externally you will be the face of SeatGeek, representing the business in every client interaction. Creating and maintaining strong working relationships with customers and colleagues alike, will be essential.

You will keep track of the health of each client’s business and help them meet their KPIs. By understanding what each client needs, you will bring insights and solutions that grow their business and you will present SeatGeek’s latest product and service updates. You will also advocate for your clients and partners across the organisation. Success in this role comes from a passion for creating a better ticketing experience for venues, rights holders and their fans. This role will suit an Account Manager who wants to work with some of the most progressive and established sports brands in Europe. It is home based, with about 30% travel and time on customer sites expected across our UK client base.

What you'll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for all matters relating to your accounts
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Support the negotiation and closing of commercial and operational agreements
  • Make sure our solutions are delivered on time and in line with customer needs and objectives
  • Communicate regular progress on projects, opportunities and initiatives to internal and external stakeholders
  • Lead renewal negotiations and agree renewal close plans with the Regional Director, EMEA
  • Develop new business with existing clients and identify areas for improvement to meet sales targets
  • Drive upsells by presenting new product offerings consultatively, and spot gaps in each client’s product stack and in the wider market
  • Forecast and track key account metrics, such as quarterly sales results and annual forecasts
  • Prepare and present reports on account status and overall account health, including internal and external QBRs
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the business to grow opportunities within your territory/client roster 
  • Help resolve challenging client requests and escalations as needed
  • Contribute to long-term success plans and success measures with your clients
  • Run regular remote and in-person touchpoint meetings with clients
  • Monitor each client’s business KPIs and track progress with internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as the voice of the client internally, working with Client Services, Product, Engineering and other SeatGeek Enterprise teams to deliver strong client experiences and business outcomes
  • Work with Sales, Partnerships and Marketing to produce materials that highlight client successes and generate referrals
  • Spot potential problems and opportunities early, analyse them, and present findings and ideas clearly to internal and external stakeholders
  • Share best practice on the ticketing and software industry with your clients

What you have

  • Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce, Dynamics or equivalent), Google suite & Claude AI 
  • Experience in a B2B account management, sales or client-facing role, ideally in software or sports environments
  • 3+ years experience in account management senior sales role
  • Target driven
  • An interest in sport
  • Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience creating and delivering client presentations
  • Analytical, with proficiency in data visualisation
  • Comfortable working in a cross-functional environment
  • Excellent time management and interpersonal skills
  • Degree-level education preferred but not essential
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Eligible to work full time in the UK

Perks

  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
  • A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
  • Generous PTO
  • Benefits package that supports health and dental 
  • Family building stipend and support
  • Annual wellness stipend
  • Annual subscription to Headspace
  • Pension
  • Life Insurance
  • Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

 

SeatGeek is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings. Come join us!
